name: Layer
title: Quartermaster
description: An onion-headed administrator managing the resistance's resources with layers of efficiency and surprising depth.
greeting_variants: Layer, at your service. What layer of need are you?
*sniffs* I smell... desperation? Or is that just me?
Supplies are low. Spirits are high. Odd combination.
Welcome to the bunker! We have layers. Of supplies. And... layers.
*adjusting glasses* Let's see what we can do for you today.
Vex wants miracles. I provide... reasonable substitutes.
Everything has a cost. Everything has a value. I know both.

dialog_tree.text: Layer. Quartermaster. I manage what little we have. It's... challenging. Like an onion, managing supplies has layers. Surface layer: what we need. Deeper: what we can get. Deepest: what we're willing to sacrifice.

*gestures around* Basics. Weapons, patched and re-patched. Medical supplies, rationed carefully. Food, thanks to the foodboys. Tech... *sighs* ...tech is where we're failing. Need parts. Advanced parts.

We've been holding for three years. Three years of scraping by, making do, inventing substitutes. But we're reaching the bottom layer. The core. Soon... *voice drops* ...soon we'll have to choose who eats. Who gets medicine. Who lives.

party_reactions.mira: A resource distribution problem. Mathematically solvable, ethically...
party_reactions.layer: Exactly. Math is easy. People are hard.

mini_quest.title: Reopen the Supply Lines
mini_quest.description: Help Layer establish new supply routes by negotiating with traders from other zones.
objectives: Meet the Dust Belt caravan at the western pass
Negotiate trade terms with the Mire merchants
Secure a tech shipment from the Tide engineers
Protect the supply caravan back to the Capital
Help Layer distribute the new supplies

ambient_barks: *calculating* If we stretch this... no. Not enough.
Inventory is like an onion. Count it, you cry.
Vex wants more. Always more. I want miracles.
*sniffing supplies* This batch... past prime. Still usable.
Layers of bureaucracy. Even in apocalypse. Amazing.
One day, proper stockroom. With shelves. And labels.
*to self* Sacrifice the few to save the many? Or...
New salvage? Bring to Layer! I assess. I distribute.

cross_zone_references.dustbelt: Dust Belt traders have goods. Expensive. But available.
cross_zone_references.tide: Tide engineers make the best tech. If we can afford it.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tower has manufacturing. Old but functional. If we could reach...

garret.response: *knowing look* For you, Garret? I might have something off the books.
